question: Can ensure_worker safely return after a durable prepared Membership, an exact accepted Herdr carrier, and target persistence while exact Session binding stays the only admission gate?

external_anchor.accepted_start_contract: not available in installed CLI help; agent start exposes only interactive-ready wait
external_anchor.consequence: The prototype may measure a synthetic exact accepted-actuation seam, but it cannot claim a live accepted-actuation latency or production safety.

ontology.launch_operation: One durable, one-shot supervision record for one Membership and one launch capability. It is not a Worker or Session.
ontology.prepared: A current Membership with its matching pending launch capability, before accepted actuation.
ontology.accepted: The exact named Herdr carrier accepted actuation and the exact terminal target are durable. It is not admission, capacity, readiness, or delivery permission.
ontology.bound: The child completed exact runtime admission, durable Session binding, and session-bound event publication for the same Membership.
ontology.failed: A non-terminal carrier or actuation fault ended the operation. Exact owned cleanup remains recorded until complete.
ontology.expired: The accepted operation missed its deadline while unbound. It is terminal only after exact owned cleanup is confirmed.
ontology.cancelled: Stop or shutdown fenced the operation before binding. It is terminal only after exact owned cleanup is confirmed.
ontology.fence: The tuple of Team, Worker, Membership, launch capability, and exact target. Runtime generation extends it after binding.
ontology.cleanup_receipt: Durable proof that only the owned target was stopped or already absent and that the exact current Membership was deactivated when still unbound.

transitions: prepared -> accepted after exact actuation acceptance, target persistence, and accepted-operation persistence
prepared -> failed after pre-acceptance restart or actuation failure
accepted -> bound only after current Membership, durable Session, and runtime generation match
accepted -> failed after early exit or pane loss before binding
accepted -> expired after deadline and fenced cleanup
prepared|accepted -> cancelled after stop or shutdown and fenced cleanup
state_machine.race_rule: Binding wins only when the durable Membership and runtime-generation evidence match before cleanup deactivation. A live unbound carrier is never reusable capacity.
state_machine.delivery_rule: No Task or alert delivery starts from prepared or accepted. Delivery starts only in the child after exact Session admission.

predictions: The synthetic accepted response will finish before the exact binding path because it excludes Pi Session construction and event observation.
A durable accepted record will make restart reconciliation possible, but it will add a new long-lived failure and cleanup owner.
The live unbound case will require a timeout and exact cleanup fence; treating it as reuse would violate the one-live-generation invariant.
The installed Herdr contract will prevent a positive live accepted-actuation conclusion.

The prototype will remain rejected as a replacement for synchronous observation unless a production-owned operation authority, compatible Herdr acceptance contract, and full real-carrier evidence are added.
acceptance_checks: Every successful accepted response has a current exact prepared Membership, matching launch capability, exact persisted target, and durable operation record.
Only exact Session/runtime evidence produces bound.
Every terminal unbound outcome records exact cleanup or fails closed with retained evidence.
Concurrent ensure creates one operation and one target; the second result is an operation receipt, not reusable capacity.
Task delivery is absent before binding and source ordering keeps it after admission.
The integrated-source recheck records source and prototype observations separately from boolean safety assertions.
The integrated-source recheck requires a live prepared carrier to produce the planner action refuse with reason unbound_live.
Raw artifacts contain source hashes, environment facts, samples, observations, safety assertions, and limits without local paths or session identities.
